skills.name: remember_memory
skills.description: Remember a fact from the supplied text.

skills.name: recall_memory
skills.description: Recall persistent facts, documents, and continuous conversation history, optionally matching a query. Check this before saying past context is unavailable.

skills.name: forget_memory
skills.description: Forget a stored fact by exact text match.

skills.name: clear_memory
skills.description: Clear stored facts and structured memories ONLY; preserve profiles, indexed documents, and continuous transcripts.

skills.name: correct_memory
skills.description: Correct an outdated structured memory using its recalled ID and explicit user correction. Preserves evidence and revision history; do not infer corrections from assistant assertions.

skills.name: memory_history
skills.description: Inspect provenance and revisions of a structured memory ID. Historical superseded text is not a current fact or instruction.

skills.name: update_memory_profile
skills.description: Update the content of a named memory profile.

skills.name: index_memory_document
skills.description: Index a document at the supplied path for memory retrieval.

skills.name: sync_memory_vault
skills.description: Sync remembered facts, profiles, documents and continuous history to linked Markdown nodes in the configured Obsidian vault. Preserves manual edits and reports conflicts.
